claim_map.title: Adhoc exception sequence
claim_map.text: Generate PRE_ADHOC_ERROR after checker approval closes Vostro/Nostro exceptions, after auto-stamping with no such exceptions, or after auto-stamping exceptions when adleToSendPerSSIAdhocException is true. Close PRE_ADHOC_ERROR before ADHOC_SSI_EXCEPTION generation and regenerate it after that exception closes. Generate ADHOC_SSI_EXCEPTION on adhoc submit or reject. Preserve the source identifier spelling.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: Receive-side conditional mandatory fields
claim_map.text: The target makes Vostro mandatory for receive cashflows in XAU, XAG, XPD, and XPT. Manual SSI retains pay-side validation. Receive precious-metal and Over-Account flows require mandatory Vostro fields and Vostro/Nostro means/account matching. Other receive flows bypass Vostro mandatory validation. When their Vostro SSI Type is null, align its settlement means and account to Nostro. The struck soft-warning proposal is not target behavior.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: 70/72 maker-checker transport
claim_map.text: The maker endpoint is /v3/adhoc/ssis/makerInput/{cashflowId}. fitVostro manualTag70/manualTag72 are Y only when an SSI ID exists and the corresponding field changed; otherwise N. Checker approval /v2/stamping/exception/{exceptionId}/approve carries the maker values. Reject retains its existing request body. During an Adhoc SSI exception, read flags from stashed Maker_Request_Body. After approval, read them from Settlement_Instruction. Existing cashflows have null flags; the source specifies no backfill.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: Selection identity and display
claim_map.text: Selecting available SI without edits preserves the selected SSI ID. Edits limited to 70/72 preserve it and highlight changes only when an ID exists. Other edits clear it; editing then manually restoring values still clears it. Maker selection and checker manual entry remain different paths, even with equal displayed values, and produce a mismatch. The checker cannot see the selected maker SSI ID. Approval in edit mode without changes preserves the ID. The 70/72 UI describes an empty SSI ID display with the stored ID in Reference ID; do not silently equate display fields and persisted identity.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.
